comment: fsd: the six slices cover all 32 user stories and amend no rules file, but they depart from the Plan in three places. (1) Slice 02 (derive a counter per edge) has no dependency on slice 01, though the Plan puts the prefactor first and its top risk says the table of today's counting is written first so every later change is checked against it: make 02 depend on gh-345/01. (2) The Plan maps 'norn doctor passes a workflow with every default unwritten and reports each new refusal with its edge or exit' to a cli integration test through the harness (seam S4), but slice 02 AC12 and slice 03 AC5 leave it to an agent in a throwaway repo: make both verifier test, a cli integration test over norn doctor. (3) Slice 05 edits the shipped workflows, which the emitted reference in docs/reference.md is generated from, yet its checks lack 'bun run docs:emit'; and slice 06 (docs) runs docs:emit with no dependency, before those files change: add 'bun run docs:emit' to slice 05's checks and make 06 depend on gh-345/05, so the docs are written against the rules as built and the reference is emitted from the final workflows.
